title: Reading Drill — Comparing reusable coffee filters — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Comparing reusable coffee filters — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The coffee stall operator in Elmbrook received an old report about filters losing their shape after repeated rinsing. The report compared changes in filter diameter, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the shape templates rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered four weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include wear from stirring. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a different drying position as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
